caption: The video captures a calm, slow-moving stream winding through a dense green forest, filmed from a fixed vantage at the water's edge. A grey rock protrudes in the left-center foreground, while the right bank is blanketed by a mat of green algae. The water mirrors the trees and a pale sky, with lens-flare artifacts—two green dots and an orange blotch—overlaying the frame. Small ripples continuously shimmer across the surface, most visibly in the central reflection patch and along the narrowed channel. Tiny pale specks dot the left half of the water. The distant bend shows a persistent, slightly faster ripple pattern consistent with a gentle current. The rock, algae mat, and tree line show no clear movement. The most visible change is in the shimmering water surface.
